digest.component_or_area: Optional dependency plumbing and S3 helper guard
propositions: The s3 optional extra must be declared in pyproject.toml as git-remote-s3>=0.3.2 with an import-based probe that reuses the existing _optional.py pattern.
require_s3_helper() must fail closed by checking both PATH availability of the git-remote-s3 console script and distribution version >= 0.3.2 using only stdlib version parsing.
Missing or too-old git-remote-s3 must raise OptionalDependencyError with an actionable message containing pip install 'nava-rebar[s3]'.
Unparseable or non-numeric version strings must fail closed rather than silently pass the minimum version check.

Unit tests must cover happy path (0.3.2 present), script missing, distribution metadata missing, version too old, version newer/suffixed, unparseable version, and guard_import behavior with monkeypatched dependencies.
